message:
2 string literals reach the DOM through a name the template binds:
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:33: interpolation reads `m` → "Delete the row"
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:35: interpolation reads `f` → "Delete "
description: Sentences a call draws through a name the template binds (measured: both drawn): a method of the string a `@let` holds, and a function a `@let` holds, called. A call is the class's — and reads nothing — only when it is read off the class and no name of the template's, so the `@let` called is followed to what it holds, and the refusal counts two.
